defect_under_test: The unified entry may misroute narrow tasks or expand local editing and claim-matching requests into unrelated modules, full-manuscript audits, external searches or unnecessary checklists.

variants.new: byte-exact 110-file current candidate runtime, excluding evaluation artifacts

runs: One fresh execution context for each case and variant; six total.
execution_context: fork_turns=none; inherited same parent model/configuration; each executor sees one raw request/material directory, one skill snapshot and its own output only; no rubric, expected answer, other case or other run.
model_note: Actual model identifier is not exposed; no model override is used.
restrictions: read only assigned skill and case-material roots
record actual skill/resource reads separately from user materials
publication_boundary: All inputs are synthetic and public. The suite tests routing and scope behavior, not scientific or editorial validity.
